description.zh:
返回信息的语言类型：

- zh：中文
- en：英文
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English

description.zh: 是否启用强制SASL身份认证，启用之后，没有进行SASL身份认证的客户端将无法访问集群
description.en: Specifies whether to enable forced Simple Authentication and Security Layer (SASL) authentication. After this feature is enabled, clients that do not perform SASL authentication cannot access the cluster

description.zh: 保留字段。
description.en: The reserved field.

description.zh: 保留字段。
description.en: The reserved field.

description.zh: 集群ID。
description.en: The cluster ID.

description.zh:
nacos配置，是否开启配置中心ram鉴权：
- `true`：开启
- `false`：关闭

> 设置此值前需要调用QueryConfig接口，获取ConfigAuthSupported参数，以查看当前集群是否支持此功能。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable RAM authentication for the configuration center in Nacos:

- `true`: enabled

- `false`: disabled

> Before you set this parameter, call the QueryConfig operation to obtain the ConfigAuthSupported parameter to check whether the current cluster supports this feature.

description.zh:
nacos配置，是否打开配置中心配置加密功能，取值如下：
- `true`：请求成功。
- `false`：请求失败。

> 设置此值前需要调用QueryConfig接口，获取ConfigSecretSupported参数，以查看当前集群是否支持此功能。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the configuration encryption feature for the configuration center in Nacos. Valid values:

- `true`: The request was successful.

- `false`: The request failed.

> Before you set this parameter, call the QueryConfig operation to obtain the ConfigSecretSupported parameter to check whether the current cluster supports this feature.

description.zh: 配置格式，包括TEXT、JSON、XML、HTML等。
description.en: The format of the configurations. Supported formats include TEXT, JSON, XML, and HTML.

description.zh: 是否开启Nacos开源控制台
description.en: Specifies whether to enable the Nacos open-source console

description.zh: 是否开启四字命令访问
description.en: Specifies whether to enable the four-character command access feature

description.zh: Nacos是否开启支持Eurka协议
description.en: Specifies whether to enable Eureka protocol support in Nacos

description.zh: zookeeper参数，是否开启TTL配置。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable TTL configuration in ZooKeeper parameters.

description.zh: zookeeper配置，实例最长连接时间，单位：秒。
description.en: The maximum connection duration of the instance. This parameter is valid for ZooKeeper instances. Unit: seconds.

description.zh: 实例ID。
description.en: The instance ID.

description.zh: zookeeper配置，每个节点最大数据量，默认是1M，单位：字节。
description.en: The maximum amount of data on each node. This parameter is valid for ZooKeeper instances. Unit: bytes.

description.zh:
nacos配置，MCP是否生效，取值如下：
- `true`：生效
- `false`：不生效
> 设置此值前需要调用QueryConfig接口，获取MCPSupported参数，以查看当前集群是否支持此功能。
description.en:
Specifies whether MCP is enabled in Nacos configuration. Valid values:

- `true`: enabled

- `false`: disabled

> Before you set this parameter, call the QueryConfig operation to obtain the MCPSupported parameter to check whether the current cluster supports this feature.

description.zh:
zookeeper配置，单个客户端与单台服务器之间的连接数。  
如果设置为0，表示不作任何限制。
description.en:
The number of connections between a single client and a single server in ZooKeeper configuration.
If this parameter is set to 0, no limits are imposed on the number of connections.

description.zh: zookeeper配置，最大超时时间，单位：秒。
description.en: The maximum timeout period in ZooKeeper configuration. Unit: seconds.

description.zh: zookeeper配置，最小超时时间，单位：秒。
description.en: The minimum timeout period in ZooKeeper configuration. Unit: seconds.

description.zh:
nacos配置，是否开启注册中心ram鉴权：
- `true`：开启
- `false`：关闭

> 设置此值前需要调用QueryConfig接口，获取NamingAuthSupporte参数，以查看当前集群是否支持此功能。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable RAM authentication for the Accreditation Centre in Nacos:

- `true`: enabled

- `false`: disabled

> Before you set this parameter, call the QueryConfig operation to obtain the NamingAuthSupporte parameter to check whether the current cluster supports this feature.

description.zh:
zookeeper配置，超级权限开关，取值如下：
- `true`：打开
- `false`：关闭
description.en:
Specifies whether super permissions are enabled. This parameter is valid for ZooKeeper instances. Valid values:

- `true`: enabled

- `false`: disabled

description.zh:
用户密码。
> 当OpenSuperAcl为true时，需要填写此值。
description.en:
The password of the account.

> This parameter is required when OpenSuperAcl is set to true.

description.zh: 扩展请求参数，JSON格式。
description.en: The extended request parameter in the JSON format.

description.zh: zookeeper配置，生成快照的频率
description.en: The frequency at which snapshots are generated in ZooKeeper configuration

description.zh: zookeeper配置，实例连接超时时间，单位：秒。
description.en: The connection timeout period of the instance. This parameter is valid for ZooKeeper instances. Unit: seconds.

description.zh: Nacos是否开启TLS传输链路加密
description.en: Specifies whether to enable TLS transmission link encryption in Nacos

description.zh: zookeeper配置，时间单元，默认为2000毫秒。
description.en: The time unit. This parameter is valid for ZooKeeper instances. Default value: 2000. Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh:
用户名称。
> 当OpenSuperAcl为true时，需要填写此值。
description.en:
The username of the account.

> This parameter is required when OpenSuperAcl is set to true.
